title: Prison
description: A sentence served as days with sparse choices (D81): the prison job and its pay, your standing, letters and visits, and parole. The figures trace to CALIBRATION.md.

wage.description: A day's pay at the prison job, in cents.

standing.description: Your standing with the staff and the parole board, 0 to 100: where it starts, and points a month for working, or lost for not (tune).

letters.description: A letter a week at most; a month without one cools a tie (D81).

visit.description: Someone outside visits once a month while their regard is at least this; a visit lifts company by so many points.

parole.description: Parole after the minimum is served (truth in sentencing): the odds in percent at a hearing, so many more or fewer for each point of standing above or below 50 in tenths; months until another hearing if denied; days on parole.

acts.description: What the people you know remember of it.
